usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/arrow-1.1/vectorize with JSON body {image:<blobUrl>, target_size:1024, auto_crop:false} (x402, $0.15) -> {jobId, status:"pending"}; then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIGN-IN-WITH-X (free) until status="complete". The blobUrl must first be produced by the File Upload flow: POST /api/upload ($0.01) -> PUT bytes to returned Vercel Blob (free) -> POST /api/upload/confirm (SIWX, free).
usage.outputShape: POST -> body.jobId (+ body.status:"pending"). Poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX) -> body.status; on body.status=="complete" the SVG is at body.result.imageUrl (a .svg blob URL). body.progress goes 0->100.
quirks: VECTORIZE is NOT a single call: the `image` field MUST be a Vercel Blob URL produced by the File Upload flow first. You cannot pass an arbitrary external image URL.

File Upload flow (3 steps): 1) POST /api/upload ($0.01 x402) with {filename,contentType} -> returns {uploadId, clientToken, pathname}. 2) PUT the raw image bytes to https://vercel.com/api/blob/?pathname=<urlencoded pathname> with headers authorization:Bearer <clientToken>, x-content-type:image/png, x-api-version:11 (free) -> returns {url}. 3) POST /api/upload/confirm (SIWX, free) with {uploadId, blobUrl:<that url>}. Use the blobUrl as `image`.

Two-step async: the vectorize POST only pays + returns {jobId, status:pending}; the actual SVG comes from polling GET /api/jobs/{jobId} which is SIGN-IN-WITH-X auth (free), signed by the SAME wallet that paid.
Live settle was exactly $0.15 (registry cap). arrow-1.1-max variant is $0.20.
Job completed fast (~10s, ready on first poll). Poll every ~5s.
Result imageUrl is an .svg blob URL that expires ~20 min - download immediately.
Pays USDC on Base, no API key. SIWX requires the polling/confirm calls to be signed by the paying wallet.
qa-pay confirmed:false because no txHash was surfaced in the settlement receipt, but payment_made/receipt.success was true (paid:true) - normal for this provider.
usage.guide: StableStudio arrow-1.1 image-to-SVG vectorizer. Pay-per-call x402 on Base, ~$0.15. You cannot vectorize an arbitrary URL: first run the File Upload flow to get a Vercel Blob URL. (1) POST /api/upload ($0.01) with {filename,contentType:"image/png"} to get {uploadId, clientToken, pathname}; (2) PUT the image bytes to https://vercel.com/api/blob/?pathname=<urlencoded pathname> with authorization:Bearer <clientToken>, x-content-type and x-api-version:11 headers (free) to get {url}; (3) POST /api/upload/confirm (SIWX, free) with {uploadId, blobUrl:url}. Then POST /api/generate/arrow-1.1/vectorize with {image:blobUrl, target_size:1024, auto_crop:false} which pays $0.15 and returns {jobId}. Finally poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} with a SIGN-IN-WITH-X signature (same wallet, free) every ~5s until body.status=="complete", then read the SVG at body.result.imageUrl and download it immediately (expires ~20 min).
